parent_protocol.scope: One bounded local compatibility experiment on complete L12 Qwen2.5-0.5B MLP. No full-model quantization, PPL, AWQ final quantization, clipping, gradients, or additional scale/alpha grid.

model.device: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4060 Laptop GPU (frozen v18 device; verify available during future preflight)
model.layer_rule: floor(num_hidden_layers/2), fixed before this experiment; not selected from v33 held results

final_gptq.selection: independent alpha per output row, shared across dynamic G128 groups; direct M2 local output MSE on all rows; exact ties choose larger alpha
final_gptq.state: each candidate starts from pristine coordinate-specific W and fresh mutable compensation state; H shared only for identical input/config

awq_D_selection.mapping: post_attention_layernorm -> shared gate_proj and up_proj; inspect full MLP output
awq_D_selection.activation_input: post_attention_layernorm output at L12 MLP boundary from read-only v18 M2 prefix
awq_D_selection.statistic: upstream get_act_scale: flatten batch/token dims, mean(abs(X)) per input channel in captured X dtype (expected FP16); record actual dtype
awq_D_selection.scale: s=act_mean**ratio; per-channel clamp min=1e-4; divide by sqrt(max(s)*min(s)); D=s, length 896
awq_D_selection.tie_break: upstream strict loss < update; exact ties keep first/smaller ratio
awq_D_selection.proxy: RTN pseudo-quantize pristine gate/up weights after multiplying input columns by D; inverse fold to original-coordinate input; run whole MLP with down_proj FP; choose minimum FP32 mean squared output error
awq_D_selection.important_format_boundary: D selector is AWQ RTN asymmetric W4G128 proxy; every final arm remains project M2 symmetric W4G128 GPTQ. Do not call final arms original AWQ or asymmetric GPTQ.
awq_D_selection.restore: restore pristine MLP state before every ratio; no candidate state carryover

equations: H_prime=D^-1@H@D^-1 when H is proportional to X.T@X
transform.fold: post_attention_layernorm weight and optional bias divide by D; gate_proj and up_proj input columns multiply by D; Linear output biases unchanged
transform.dtype: Mirror upstream arithmetic: activation mean, power, clamp and normalization remain in captured X dtype (expected FP16); retain native-dtype D for folding and store an FP32 reporting copy. Cast D to each parameter/input dtype before in-place operations; hash each representation and post-fold tensors.
transform.hessian: rebuild H from actual X_prime; redo dead-column handling, damping and native factorization; do not transform/reuse already damped H
transform.boundary: D changes shared gate/up input coordinates only; after committing gate/up, recompute arm-specific SiLU(gate)*up down input and H_down

data.unit: whole article; never split documents into pseudo-independent token groups
data.order: after exclusion, sort by SHA256(dataset fingerprint || full-article SHA256)
data.assignment: first 16 S0 search; next 16 S0 held; next 16 S1 search; next 16 S1 held
data.pre_gpu_exclusion: exclude IDs/full-text/token hashes in v18 formal calibration, all v24/v31/v32/v33 manifests and all prior calibration/search/held lists, plus WT2 test/C4 evaluation. Materialize/hash manifest before GPU. If fewer than 64 disjoint whole articles remain, stop without shrinking or substituting history.
data.selection_data: search only for activation statistics, D, GPTQ H and alpha
data.held_data: unread until D/alpha selection lock is saved; evaluate only

prefix_and_reference.prefix_checkpoint: v18 M2 final checkpoint, read-only, for all upstream layers and existing L12 attention path
prefix_and_reference.target_weights: pristine FP16 weights from the same frozen model revision; do not take target MLP W from quantized M2 checkpoint
prefix_and_reference.common_input: capture post_attention_layernorm output before target MLP; identical X for A/B/C/D within a split
prefix_and_reference.reference: unquantized target L12 MLP output using common prefix input and pristine target MLP weights
prefix_and_reference.candidate_scoring: direct FP32; gate/up candidate output X_prime@Q_prime.T versus X@W.T, including FP16 fold drift; each down candidate uses arm-specific freshly propagated input and pristine down weight
prefix_and_reference.held_outputs: all gate/up/down rows and full MLP output versus the same split's common unquantized target MLP reference
prefix_and_reference.next_boundary: capture complete L12 decoder-block output as actual L13 input for each arm; no full model after L13 and no PPL

arms.A: original coordinates; native dynamic GPTQ alpha=1 for gate/up/down
arms.B: original coordinates; M2 scalar10 with independent search-selected alpha per output row
arms.C: same split-specific D folded into postnorm and both gate/up; transformed-coordinate native GPTQ alpha=1
arms.D: exact same split-specific D as C; transformed-coordinate M2 scalar10

contrasts.D-B: combined method versus current scalar10; primary held contrast

arms.prefix: common frozen v18 M2 prefix through L12 immediately before MLP
arms.down_input: separate capture and H for A/B/C/D after gate/up commit
arms.sharing: A/B share original gate/up banks; C/D share transformed gate/up banks; down banks are arm-specific; no bank/H shared across splits

correctness: FP64/FP32 real-transform equality and source-compatible FP16 folded unquantized MLP/block drift
ratio 0 / D=I regression of baseline input and parameter hashes within frozen tolerance

independent native alpha1 parity for gate/up shared states and each actual down input state (A/B/C/D), both coordinates and both splits: group-entry compensated weights, scale, zero, g_idx, final weights and direct all-row outputs
pristine W/H hashes unchanged; every alpha has fresh mutable GPTQ compensation state
for each split and coordinate, replay one complete down_proj alpha after another alpha; weights/qparams/scores must match
stitch all rows W/scale/zero/g_idx; verify A/C alpha1 and B/D search-selected candidates
after whole gate/up commit, refresh once per arm for actual down input/H; verify full L12 MLP and real L13 input boundary; never refresh per row batch
do not read held scores before selection lock is written

gptq_candidates.gate_up_per_split: four full Linear banks (original gate/up and transformed gate/up) x10 = 40
gptq_candidates.down_per_split: A alpha1 1 + B alpha10 + C alpha1 1 + D alpha10 = 22

unique_hessians.composition: one original gate/up H; one transformed gate/up H; four arm-specific down H

cache_io.all_candidate_weight_bank_upper_bound: 124 x 4864 x 896 x 2 bytes ~= 1.01 GiB if every FP16 matrix is persisted
cache_io.resume: stream one complete Linear alpha candidate; persist all-row score vector, current best stitched rows/qparams per arm, hashes and completed-candidate journal at each Linear boundary; persist selected tensors and D
cache_io.destination: new v34-only cache; never write historical paths

gpu_budget.abort: after first full split, update forecast from synchronized actual full-matrix timings; if projected cumulative wall exceeds 25 minutes, do not start next split; never pass 30 minutes
gpu_budget.timing_reference: v18 FORMAL_TIMING.csv at 128x2048: per-candidate gate GPTQ/score 0.3420/0.6600s; up 0.3455/0.6594s; down 1.8632/0.9236s

estimate_seconds.awq_full_mlp_proxy: rough upper proxy 90 s using same-shape summed M2 score means for 40 full MLP passes; RTN fakequant overhead not separately timed
estimate_seconds.prefix: about 34 s by linear scaling v18 M1 activation refresh stages to four 16-article inputs; estimate only

gpu_budget.planning_envelope: approximately 6-10 GPU minutes including load, I/O and unmeasured proxy overhead; estimate only, not a benchmark

held_gate.primary: D must improve full-MLP held output MSE versus B by >=1% in both S0 and S1, and exceed 5x measured same-split FP16 unquantized-fold error
held_gate.per_projection: no gate/up/down pooled held MSE regression >5% versus B
held_gate.row_tail: at most 5% of projection rows regress >10%; any individual row regression >50% fails
held_gate.report: absolute/relative held loss per arm and split; C-A,D-C,D-B; all projections/rows; W/T/L, median, worst, concentration and D/alpha distributions; no held oracle
held_gate.stop: if correctness, article exclusion, budget or any quality/tail gate fails, preserve negative results and stop; never alter target, data, grid or thresholds

prohibited: AWQ auto_clip or M2 clipping changes
online inference speedup or novelty claims
